dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt software (JMA standard receipt software), likely compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Program ORCGX04 is part of the ORCA (JMA standard receipt) system for check master information settings.
evidence: no EXEC CICS/SQL, no COMP-3, fixed format, Linux/GnuCOBOL conventions

purpose.domain_detail: JMA ORCA standard medical receipt (claims) software - check master information settings subsystem (X04 component)
purpose.summary: ORCGX04 is a component of the JMA ORCA medical receipt system handling check master (checkmaster) information settings. It manages disease name (byomei) lists, search/filter functionality for disease codes, group management, and related master data maintenance for medical insurance claims processing in Japan.

notable_features: Large SPA (screen parameter area) working storage structures with OCCURS clauses
459 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
No COMP-3 usage (unusual for financial/medical billing - uses PIC 9 instead)
Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS garbled)
Fixed-format source with max line length 74
verdict.notes: Comments contain Japanese text that appears garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The program is clearly part of the well-known open-source JMA ORCA medical receipt system.
